patch_description:
The current ansatz uses one shared angle per block, producing 6 circuit parameters plus the gain and bias. Although it reaches perfect accuracy, its validation/test L2 losses remain around 0.03/0.02 and it carries 8 trainable parameters.

The proposed block contains only a fixed CZ gate. Since CZ commutes with every fixed Z-Z readout observable—and six identical repetitions also compose to the identity—this preserves the dataset’s native correlator signal without unnecessary trainable transformations. The model therefore trains only the readout gain and bias, reducing the total parameter count from 8 to 2, increasing parameter efficiency, reducing circuit depth and gate count, and avoiding noisy or redundant circuit-parameter optimization. The fixed Adam settings remain learning rate 0.03, 30 steps per epoch, batch size 15, convergence threshold 0.90, and validation-loss early stopping with patience 75 and minimum improvement 1e-4.
